title: APPROVE Motion by Bass, Yaroslavsky, Padilla, Butts, Solis, and Horvath to direct the CEO to: A. ENSURE the following criteria will be applied when…
summary: Directing the CEO to establish criteria for Open Streets grant applications with a maximum of $250,000 per event and a minimum of 3 consecutive miles of street closure, and to report back within 120 days on funding alternatives for programs beginning in FY 2028.

details.action: Establishing Open Streets grant criteria and funding framework

flag.reason: Sets a $250,000 cap and minimum route length for Open Streets grants, shaping which street-closure events get funded.
